selection: positive-X blue base of the RMUC2027 V1 field (blue-coloured base parts visual_118; the red base is at negative X). Armor = the plate directly below the green guidance lamp, facing the field centre; confirmed by the user 2026-10-21.
surface_evidence: Measured from mesh visual_117 (light-grey plate set, three plates at 120 deg): the field-facing plate's vertices give a 2.5 mm thick plate whose outward (top) surface centre is (11.4561, 0.0003, 1.0790) m with outward normal (-0.4617, 0, 0.887), i.e. 27.5 deg from vertical, and in-plane extents 0.129 m across (world Y) by 0.114 m along the slope. Mesh face winding points inward, so the outward sign is taken toward +Z. Green lamp visual_116: centre (11.4944, 0, 1.2424), 57 x 55 mm, dome mean normal (-0.968, 0, 0.25). A dark frame (visual_115) surrounds the plate edges.
marker_source: RMUC2027 V1 field mesh visual_116 (green lamp geometry); rulebook optical specification still from RMUC 2026 V2.2.0
provenance: Measured RMUC2027 V1 target geometry, retained in the repaired moving-base field. Lower plate contact surfaces are corrected and the green lens has a closed collider. Engineering geometry, not a real-field survey; original RMUC2026 estimate remains in base_target_rmuc2026.json.
armor_dimensions_note: [across (horizontal, world Y), along slope, measured thickness]; collision proxies may use a thicker box behind the surface.

marker_motion.note: marker_center_m is at q=0; the lower armor center stays fixed when the lamp moves.

contact_region_basis: Central 90 x 100 mm ray audit footprint already used in test_repaired_arena.py; excludes the surrounding frame. Not a new official scoring area.
